svg.title: Recall by entity type
svg.desc: Heatmap of overlap recall per entity type and system on the smoke fixtures.
svg.text: Overlap recall per entity type (share of gold spans found), per system

Fixture set 'smoke' (hand-written; de 10 docs + en 10 docs + es 5 docs + fr 5 docs + ga 5 docs + hr 5 docs + hu 31 docs + it 5 docs + lt 5 docs + lv 5 docs + mt 5 docs + nl 5 docs + ro 5 docs + sl 5 docs), de + en + es + fr + ga + hr + hu + it + lt + lv + mt + nl + ro + sl pooled (micro-averaged). Cells are recall in %; n = gold spans of the type.

Not shown, not run on every current fixture file (de + en + es + fr + ga + hr + hu + it + lt + lv + mt + nl + ro + sl): rules, fast, NER v2.0 (published watt-mind/pii-guard-ner-xlmr-base, LAB-1306), rules + Muse Spark Open (Baseten), rules + Muse Glimmer (low), Presidio, LLM Guard, PrivAiTe.
(kept) types are not masked by policy, so they cannot leak. Comparison tools have no recognisers for Hungarian identifiers.
Runs no runs · commits · generated by `pii-guard eval report` from eval/results/runs/
